Excellent lunch!
Oct 2026 • Couples
We ate here for lunch after a long day spent visiting Hué. 
We were welcomed with great kindness by May who looked after us throughout the meal, explaining the dishes we were tasting and also how to assemble them correctly. 
The food is excellent, there is a wide variety of dishes, all very typical of the tradition. 
I got the combo to taste all the main dishes from Hué, they were truly delicious. 
Thanks again to May who even gave us an extra portion of chè hạt sen so that we could both taste it!

Superb discovery
Oct 2026 • Couples
Superb discovery! We had the spring rolls, the bánh ram ít, the lemongrass skewers (nem lụi), and the bánh bột lọc: everything was truly delicious! 🤤

In addition to the food, the atmosphere is very pleasant. The staff is cheerful, smiling, in a good mood, and gives very good advice.

An excellent place to discover the specialties of Hué. We recommend it without hesitation!
